text: Broad community governance of AI training identifies and mitigates bias more effectively than data validation alone, because validation focused approaches can overlook systemic biases already embedded in the pretrained model.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4796714
abstract: Moreover, involving a broad community in the governance of AI training can help identify and mitigate biases more effectively than a focus on data validation alone, which might overlook systemic biases embedded in the pretrained models.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: compares community governance of training against post hoc data validation
concerns systemic bias baked in during pretraining
